messages.text: Hi Dhruv, thanks for stopping by our stall. Sharing the details of the CS-450 carton sealer we discussed.
Thanks Amit. We pack about 1,200 cartons a shift. Will it handle that?
Yes, it does up to 18 cartons a minute, so 1,200 per shift is comfortable.
Please send the quote for 2 units. Also what is the delivery time to Pune?
Sure Dhruv, quote going out today. Delivery is about 3 weeks from order.
Okay. What are your payment terms? We usually do 30 days after delivery.
Namaste Kavita ji, quote for the case erector sent on mail. Please check.
Haan mila. Rate theek lag raha hai.
Great. Koi doubt ho toh batayiye, I can arrange a call with our engineer.
Nahi, sab clear hai. Please send PI, hum advance bhej dete hain.
Hello Pooja, sharing the specs for our LB-120 labelling machine for your bottles.
Thanks Sana. Can you send a brochure or a short video of it running?
Here is the brochure and a 2 minute demo video link: https://example.com/lb120-demo
Looks good. We are interested, but no fixed timeline yet. Will keep you posted.
Hi Rohit, following up on the strapping machine enquiry for your spice cartons.
Hi Vikram. Yes, we need one for the new godown line.
Great, I will send the SM-60 details and price range.
Details sent on mail, please have a look.
Got it. I will discuss internally with my partner and revert.
Hello Sameer, thanks for filling the form. Which pouch size are you looking to pack?
200g and 500g pouches, mostly namkeen and mixes.
Our FFS-200 handles both sizes with a quick changeover. Sharing the product sheet.
Thanks, received. We are still exploring options.
Happy to answer anything you need, Sameer. Sharing a few customer photos of the machine too.
Nice, thanks for sending.
Hi Farhan, we met at the show. Sharing the labelling machine options for your vials.
Thanks Sana. Interesting, but our budget for this year is already used up.
Understood. Would a financing option help?
Not now, next quarter. Please contact us in January.
Namaste Ritu ji, shrink wrapper ka quote bhej raha hun aapke namkeen packs ke liye.
Haan ji mil gaya, dekh ke batati hun. Abhi thoda busy hai season ki wajah se.
Ritu ji, quote ke baare mein kuch socha? Chahein toh demo bhi dikha sakta hun.
Ritu ji, ek baar phir check kar raha hun. Offer mein kuch change chahiye toh bata dijiye.
Hi Harsh, sharing the labelling machine quote as discussed.
Thanks Neha. Honestly we have a budget freeze at the moment till the new financial plan is done.
No problem, I will check back later.
Sure. Management has paused all new equipment purchases for now.
Namaste Arjun ji, case erector ki details bhej di hain mail pe.
Dekh li bhai. Accha lag raha hai, thoda discuss karna hai.
Zaroor, kab baat kar sakte hain?
Mujhe 30 Oct ko call karna, subah 11 baje. Abhi plant visit pe hun.
Hi Vivek, sharing the quote for the SW-300 shrink wrapper for your biscuit packs.
Thanks Neha. The price is too high for us.
I understand. Can I know the target price you have in mind?
SealRite quoted us almost 20% less for a similar machine.
Our machine has a heavier frame and 2 year warranty. I can share a comparison sheet if useful.
Hello Meera, our CS-300 carton sealer suits your order volumes. Shall I send the quote?
Yes please, send the price for 3 units.
Quote sent. Please check and tell me if you need any change.
Looks fine. We decide by 6 Nov after the board meeting, will confirm then.
Hi Sanjay, sharing the details of our FFS-80 sachet machine for your granules.
Thanks Sana. We have a plant shutdown this month.
No worries. Let me know when you are free to discuss.
Please call me on 4 Nov, we will be back and can discuss properly.
Hi Pallavi, following up on the strapping machine enquiry from the show.
Hi Vikram. We are interested in an automatic strapping machine for milk crates.
Sharing the SM-90 details. It handles crates up to 600 mm.
Thanks, nice. Interested but no plan to buy yet, maybe later in the year.
